quests.title: To Colorfall Cliffs!

dialogue.t: Here we are! So these must be the Foamflower Fields marked on the map.
How come it's all so... green?
Looks more like the Foamgrass Fields to me.
Haha, it's not exactly what I imagined, either... But, that happens a lot!
You mean false advertising? Yeah, when it's as bad as this, I usually file a complaint.
Otherwise, my tour groups would file a complaint about me!
No, no. Sorry, I should've been more specific.
I mean more like... when reality doesn't live up to your expectations. That happens to me a lot.
Oh, because of...
Yeah. It's things like... climbing to the top of a mountain to see the view, only for a thick fog to roll in, you can barely see two feet in front of you.
Or gathering a bunch of firewood, only to find that a Pyro Slime snuck into your tent and set it all on fire...
Oh, man. That's rough...
Eh, I've gotten used to it by now. What adventure doesn't have a few bumps in the road?
So, when you think about it, being able to enjoy this vast, open scenery, fresh air all around and no monsters in sight... I'd call that some pretty remarkable luck!
What's even more remarkable is your ability to stay positive.
Oh, hey. I think the Asha found something. Pretty sure that's what that sound means.
Geez, you can understand each other already? You two must be on the same wavelength or something!
Wow. The archiest of arch-enemies...
If they were both people, maybe they could sit down and talk it out, but... But one's an Asha.
C'mon, let's lend a hand! You ready, Asha?
Whoa, wait a second. How did we skip straight to action mode? Paimon doesn't even know what the game plan is.
If you think about what the Asha love doing most, it must be dyeing things different colors, right?
Yeah... And?
And they're simple, pure-hearted beings.
So, I doubt that Asha is here to cause trouble on purpose. The little guy probably just can't stand how dull and uninspiring all this plain grass looks.
Yeah, and it's not like he could communicate any of that...
Right! So if we help dye the meadow in a range of vibrant colors... Y'know, turn it into an actual flower field...
...We can make that Asha happy and help out the staff member at the same time!
Took the words right out of my mouth!
Huh, a little conflict mediation... I like the way you think. You've got peacemaker potential.
I'm in.
Haha, stop... that tickles...! Oh, are we going somewhere? Is it far? I should let my friends know first—
Wait, where are you—
Hey, interpreter — did you catch any of that?
Maybe something needs to be moved? Or there's someone else nearby who needs our help even more...?
Okay, those two things sound completely unrelated! What are you even basing that off of?
Well, the longer I watch Asha, the more their body language reminds me of saurians.
Huh... You better not be lying to me.

No, I'm serious. In saurian body language, the same movement can often mean unrelated things. When my saurian mom raised her wings, it either meant "come home early for dinner" or "you're in big trouble, kid."
Wait, then how did you tell the difference?
When I was little, I couldn't. Lemme tell you, I walked straight into a lot of punishments...
Wow, super sturdy, and fast too... So this is a Natlanese hot air balloon? It's awesome!
Up here, everyone! Look! We're back!
Whoa, it looks incredible! The Foamflower Fields finally live up to their name!
Great work, everyone! Now we've just gotta let that staff member know, right?
Please, everyone, wait up... *panting*
Talk about perfect timing!
It's okay. Catch your breath first...
*huff*... Phew, alright. I'm the staff member in charge of the main event here at Colorfall Cliffs — the Airborne Asha challenge.
Just now, gazing down from above, I saw the meadow suddenly transform into a sea of flowers. And the colors were so stunning... I almost dropped my binoculars!
Y—You truly are the saviors of Colorfall Cliffs!
It was nothing, hehe. Besides, these two did most of the work!
Kind-hearted adventurers, would the pair of you consider taking part in our challenge?
Or rather... Would you do us the honor of bringing some color to our landmarks too?
That sounds awesome... But are you sure we're allowed to do that?
Of course, of course! I would love nothing more!
You did my colleague such a huge favor, so it's only right that I thank you on his behalf. And I figured an experience like this would be even more special than a monetary reward!
Uhh, no. We want the—
What she means is, we'd be delighted to help you out! Haha... So, how do we get there?
Please, follow me. We'll take the hot air balloon up.
Alright, we're here. This, ladies and gentlemen, is the Airborne Asha.
Whoa, it's so cool! I didn't expect it to be this big...
Once it's painted, I bet we'll be able to see it from miles off.

Oh, for sure! As long as you're in an open area and the view isn't blocked by mountains, you'll be able to see it from anywhere — whether that's the rooftop pool on Huha Hill or the fjords on Tete Isle.
That's awesome! Your work's gonna be center stage — you've got this!
Man, I'm getting excited already! Should I go with my lucky color? Or maybe...
Wow, he sure had a lot to say this time, huh.
Did you catch any of that, Chasca? Mind translating for us again?
Hmm, that was a lot to take in. It'll take me some time to sort out all the different possibilities...
It's okay, I think I got the gist! The Asha wants to team up with me and compete against {NICKNAME}.
He likes helping people out by working together with friends.
But, it's the element of competition that turns ordinary activities into exciting adventures, and that's what he enjoys the most.
He really said all that!?
Haha, more or less! I filled in the gaps here and there.
From his reaction, it looks like you got it spot on. The bond between you guys really is growing stronger...
Alright, Asha. I like that idea, but we should make sure {NICKNAME} thinks it sounds fun too, right?
It's always important to check in with your friends and respect their opinions!

dialogue.sit: A chance to challenge our team captain — just what I've been waiting for.
As long as you two are happy, that's all that matters.
Even against all five of you, I'd still come out on top.

dialogue.t: "Then let the games begin."
Haha... Sorry, with you looking at me like that, I just can't say that with a straight face.
Alright, well if both teams are ready, then follow me! I'll be the referee.
As long as you two are happy, that's all that matters.
Hey, we can't be the only ones having fun! I want you to enjoy it too, {NICKNAME}.
C'mon, no stress! Let's just have fun!
Even against all five of you, I'd still come out on top.
I like the confidence! Alright then, I'll give it my all, too.
Hey, how could you even think of going against Paimon! We're a team!
Haha, that was so much fun! Thanks for a good match, {NICKNAME}! The Asha and I had a great time!

dialogue.sit: I'd say it was pretty even.
You and the Asha made a brilliant team.
I should have asked for Paimon's help.

dialogue.t: Nice work up there, guys!
Congratulations for taking home the win, {NICKNAME}. And a big shout out to our magnanimous benefactor and his Asha companion for their amazing teamwork!
When I heard you interpret what the Asha was saying earlier, I didn't quite believe it. But after this match, I have to say, I'm truly impressed...
Same here! Both of you had me on the edge of my seat the whole time! It felt just like watching the finals of the Pilgrimage!
Yeah, honestly, the more heated things got out there, the more I wanted to fly up and fire off a few bullets myself.
What, you got paintballs on you or something?
Something like that — the final color would be a bit of an unknown, though. And I couldn't guarantee that Asha would stay airborne after I was done with it...
Uhhh...
Hehe! Well, we're now just one step away from completing the Airborne Asha.
Our two heroes just need to light up the Airborne Asha's brushes!
Looks amazing, right? I can recommend a viewpoint that'd be perfect for a group photo!
You and the Asha made a brilliant team.
I should have asked for Paimon's help.
Oh, so now you remember Paimon? Bit late for that!
Alright! The Airborne Asha's looking great, and everyone's in the frame. Chasca, move a little closer to the middle!
Hehe, a job well done!
Everyone ready?
Hey, you need to get in the picture too!
Yep, yep, just one sec and we're good! Okay, all set!
Three, two, one...
Asha!

quests.description: Bennett told you about a scenic spot called “Foamflower Fields” at Colorfall Cliffs…

quests.title: To Guiztli Ridge!

dialogue.t: Brave adventurers, welcome to Villa Guiztli! You're just in time to witness our annual Pome Night celebration!
Oooh, Paimon likes the sound of that! This place has a great vibe already!
Hello there, Mr...?
Nanasian.
Excuse me, Mr. Nanasian, could you point us in the direction of the town? Is there anything we should bring?
Haha. Just from hearing your question, I can tell I'm speaking to an experienced adventurer.
Just head downhill from here, and you'll soon arrive at the charming town of Villa Guiztli.
As for things to take... You'll need a bold spirit, a heart eager to help others, and a dash of courage to face any challenges that may lie ahead.
Ah, I see you've brought a little companion along with you. Would you mind keeping him in your bag for now, just in case something... unexpected happens?
Okay, all set! Brave challengers, your adventure is about to begin. I wish you all an exciting and unforgettable night ahead!
Whoa, this cave's way bigger than Paimon expected. Looks like a lot of work was put into this town.
Hey, is that... a bounty board?
Let Paimon see... One zero, two zeros, three zeros, four...
Five zeros, six zeros... and there's even a five in front! ... That's five million Mora! Holy— Eek, something's coming!
Esteemed guests, welcome to the beautiful town of Villa Guiztli.
...Geez, you almost gave Paimon a heart attack!
You must be here for Pome Night. *sigh* I'm sorry to report we won't be celebrating the festival this year.
Oh, did something happen?
Not long ago, those Nochtli ruffians ransacked our beautiful town and seized all our gold and treasure.
Even now, their ringleader's still holed up in the town. And worse — not only is he refusing to leave, he expects us to do his bidding.
That's awful! Can't you do something about it?
Well, it's a long story. Anyway, you all made quite the journey to get here. Why don't we head over to the bar for a quick drink?
What happened next, Sheriff?
He disappeared... and no one knows what happened after that.
Some say he took a new name. Others claim he and his companions embarked on a one-way journey to a land as hot as the blazing sun...
If you ever happen to run into him, please let him know how grateful we are for everything he did for us — and also, that we miss him very much.
If we see him, we'll make sure to pass the message along.
Alright, this is the Nochtli gang's hideout. I tailed one of their henchmen once, so I know how to activate the door mechanism, and I can get it open for you.
But this place is under heavy watch. I'll be a sitting duck if I go alone. So, I need some backup.
What do you need us to do?
Knock out anyone who tries to get in my way.
Hehe, now that's a gutsy request.
Leave it to me.
Heh, I knew Chasca wouldn't need a lot of convincing on that one...
{NICKNAME}, cover that gun for me, will you?
Copy that.
Man, wish we had backup like this all those times we had to go sneaking around...
Hmph, wow, you won, {NICKNAME}. You're a pretty good shot. Almost seems like you've done this before.
Here, let me teach you how to fire off rapid bursts of bullets. It might come in handy someday.
Oh, shoot!
Wh—What happened?
I got distracted for a split second, and now the Sheriff's been caught...
Let's go after him!
Too bad, you handled that gun pretty well. Guess you just haven't had enough chances to practice.
Here, let me teach you how to fire off rapid bursts of bullets. It might come in handy someday.
Oh, shoot!
Wh—What happened?
I got distracted for a split second, and now the Sheriff's been caught...
Let's go after him!

dialogue.section: Bennett, Mualani, Chasca, "El Capoctus Joquiratto", Nochtli Lackey

dialogue.t: Aha, the meddling outsiders have arrived, I see.
Ah! Careful, boss, they got a gun!
A little firepower's got you spooked? Hah, disappointing.
Alright then, show-offs, let's see who's the quicker shot.
There's a ton of smoke over there. What happened?
He got away.
Whoa, no one outruns Chasca's gun...
Truth is, the leader never planned to fight us. All that talk was just a distraction — a way to create an opening. He was planning to make a run for it all along.
Hmph, acting all tough and then running away like that... What a joke.
Uh-oh... The exit's blocked. Looks like another trap.
What should we do? Is there some kind of mechanism we can use?
Look, there's a bunch of cages down in the canyon. Let's go save those captives first.
Alright, we've dealt with those monsters, and the Abyssal energy seems to be gone too.
Is everyone okay?
I got a scrape on my arm, but it's nothing. Doesn't even hurt.
Let me take a look.
Oh, sure... Sorry for making you worry...
Glad to hear it.
Don't you think something weird's going on?
I mean... those Hilichurl Rogues could be actors in costume. But, there shouldn't be any actual Abyssal monsters here, right?
Yeah, there's no way that's meant to be part of the experience.
Plus, the way we came in is blocked now. Everything was fine until the monsters showed up...
Oh no... My bad luck must be back... and I'm dragging everyone down with me...
Hey, don't think like that.
Abyssal monsters can appear for many reasons. Being attracted by someone or... something is certainly one possibility.
Now isn't the time to blame ourselves. We should focus on identifying any hidden dangers instead.
We still don't know what might have happened outside the cave.
You're right. Okay, I'll take the lead and scout ahead!
Hah, sorry. I'm gonna have to call dibs on that one.
We should do this the Natlan way. As the most mobile member of the team, leave the scouting to me. It happens to be a Flower-Feather Clan specialty.
Alright, I'll go check on the situation outside. See you soon.
Wait but, the cave's still...
Get back.
Wait a sec, we're not ready y—
Heh, she sure is a fast flyer. I can't even see her anymore...
Well at least there's a way out now... Wait, what are you looking at?
The Tecpatl's Flintblades Adventure Team, Anja, Macani... Huh, Paimon doesn't recognize any of those names.
Hmm... Neither do I.

dialogue.sit: But it didn't say if anything else happened afterwards...

dialogue.t: Well, guess we're still pretty much in the dark, then. We should just make a note of it and move on for now.
Everything okay, Bennett?
Oh... Yeah, I'm fine. You guys think it's probably better not to move anything around in the amusement area, right?
Yeah, better not.
Alright then, let's go.
But it didn't say if anything else happened afterwards...
It hasn't been contaminated.
（test）BOSS出现的演出
Let him go.
Surrender now, and maybe, just maybe, I'll let him live.
Whew, that was one big hill... Paimon's hair is dry already. Wait, that's... Chasca!
And El Capoctus Joquiratto!
And Nana... Uh, Paimon forgot the rest...
Shush...
I'll say it one last time — if you want him to live, drop your weapons and surrender!
You shoot or try any other funny business, and I'll throw him right off this cliff.
Please... I'm begging you, don't do this...
That's weird... What's Chasca waiting for?

dialogue.sit: Maybe there really is a bad guy...

dialogue.t: Huh? You mean like... someone replaced the actor?
If we factor in those Abyssal monsters that came out of nowhere, does that mean this is...
...Actually real!?
Enough! Even my patience has its limits.
Back off now, all of you! Get away from the cliff!
Run, adventurers, run! Leave the town, leave me to my fate!
(Hey, that's...!)
Boom!
Well that's that.
Thank you, brave adventurers! You saved Villa Guiztli, and you saved me too!
Hey, look over there!
Asha...?
El Capoctus Joquiratto... was played by a bunch of Asha!?
Congratulations, everyone! You bravely chose the path of justice and vanquished the wicked El Capoctus Joquiratto!
Okay, okay, hold on... So, it wasn't real? We all freaked out for nothing?
I mean, there was cause for concern — I was worried, too.
Even though I didn't see any other Abyssal monsters on the way here, I didn't let my guard down.
Under normal circumstances, I would've taken the shot without hesitation. With Soulsniper on my side, I'm confident I could get to the hostage no problem, even if the hostile tried to harm them.
But this time, it seemed like our enemy was tainted by the Abyss, so we couldn't afford to take any chances. We had to factor in the worst-case scenario.
So, the only option was for {NICKNAME} and I to strike at the same time, ensuring we took down the villain and rescued the hostage in one fell swoop.
Wow, good thing you two got a chance to work on your teamwork against those lackeys earlier...
In hindsight, it's clear the only place where things went wrong was that cave.
So, since we cleared out those monsters already, we're in the clear?
We should be.
Sorry, I don't follow. By "cave," you're not referring to somewhere inside one of our amusement facilities, are you...?
Yeah, we came across an adventurer camp inside the cave. Y'know, near the spot where the Sheriff snuffs it... Oh, um, sorry. That came out a little harsh...
But... There's no cave or camp anywhere near there...
You sure it wasn't your eyes playing tricks on you?
No, definitely not. First, we were ambushed by monsters, then we even read through the adventurer's notes. There's no way it was just an illusion.
Oh, we even have evidence! The scratch on my arm is still there! Haha, guess there was a silver lining to getting hurt, after all.
Huh? But... that can't be...
Villa Guiztli's meant to be a fully immersive experience. There's no way we'd leave in design flaws that didn't fit the theme...
That's... actually a good point.
So, is something else going on here, then? Paimon's getting a bad feeling all of a sudden...
...Disguised as the villain?
Those guests don't look like they're fooling around... And where'd the cave come from anyway?

dialogue.section: "Willapi", Bennett, Mualani, Chasca, Asha, "El Capoctus Joquiratto"

dialogue.t: Ahh, I feel a bit more relaxed now.
Yeah. Honestly, it's our fault for messing with stuff that wasn't part of the attraction... Gah, this whole part of the trip's been an emotional rollercoaster.
Wait, are you two still thinking about it?

dialogue.sit: If no one knew that cave was there...
...Do you think it could be related to Tenochtzitoc?

dialogue.t: Yeah... I also think that adventure team's story is real, but I wouldn't be surprised if it took place a long, long time ago.
Like... before this resort was even built.
We're here! You must have been waiting for us to take a group photo, right?
Wait, that reminds Paimon... Wasn't the bounty for getting rid of El Capoctus Joquiratto five... million... Mora!?
Yeah, I don't think we're gonna see a single coin of that. If they actually had to cough up Mora every time he got captured, Villa Guiztli would have gone under a long time ago.
Hehe, exactly! The prize isn't real Mora, just a commemorative Mora-shaped chocolate coin stamped with that number.
But since the chocolates aren't ready yet, I'll give you some Easybreeze Badges you can exchange for other items of your choice.
Oh, well... Paimon would have preferred the chocolate, but other gifts are fine too.
I'll get the Kamera ready.
Three, two, one...
Cactus!
...Do you think it could be related to Tenochtzitoc?

quests.description: Chasca told you about some head-to-head challenges at Guiztli Ridge…

quests.title: To Wavey Bay!

dialogue.t: Woohoo!
Sunshine, waves, and koholasaurs!
Aaand the minute she sees the water, it's like the rest of us don't exist. Paimon thought "Umo{RUBY#[S]Unity}ja" meant no person left behind...
Quick, this way! C'mon guys, stop lollygagging... Let's go!
Oh! Coming, coming!
Look, tell me what you see.
A wooden plank.
Not just any old wooden plank. Read what it says!
Ohhh, it's a sightseeing map.
Exactly! This map is as precious as a key to a vault of untold treasures...
Yeah, I see that! It's like a call to adventure!
Yes! Or, like a burning ember of phlogiston!
Phlogiston? Oh... That's a type of energy, isn't it? So, is a map like phlogiston because... just a little spark is enough to light a fire under someone?
Exactly! And just like phlogiston, a map is super important!
With a map to guide your way, you're free to carve out your very own path of adventure!
Hehe, freedom and adventure! I like the sound of that!
Whoa, whoa, hold your horses, folks... Why does Paimon feel like Mualani's hiding something?
Alright, everyone, time for solo exploration!
Wait, what kind of tour guide calls it quits the minute we get to the part where we're supposed to, y'know... TOUR!?

dialogue.sit: Maybe Mualani just wants to go off on her own?

dialogue.t: Hehe, spoken like a true friend. I won't forget that you had my back!
Here, just take a look. These two major attractions have been marked "Under Testing." My guess is that they've run into some issues.

So, if we split up, we all get to check out the attractions we're interested in, and we can help out with the testing at the same time! Maybe we'll even get Wavey Bay up and running sooner than expected!
Oh, so you were looking out for the group the whole time... Sorry. Paimon thought you were just obsessing over water activities...
Hehe, don't sweat it. Why don't we regroup near that giant koholasaur building when we're done?
Based on the guiding experience I've racked up over the years, my gut tells me the entrance to the main challenge should be somewhere around there!
Sure.
Alright then, let's split up. Don't forget to keep checking the map!
Even a "guide" deserves a vacation.
Sharp eyes! I didn't expect you to spot me all the way up here.
Looks like you've taken an interest in the facilities here as well.
I think they're pretty good, but "fun" is subjective. What I say's not gonna sway you, you'll have to try it for yourself.
See that track over there?
Use paintballs to color the balls lined up on the tracks. Once they're all the same color, the balls will disappear with a "bang."
By which I mean that someone else might be standing nearby with their own gun. They'll be waiting to send those colored balls flying when the time's right.

dialogue.sit: I almost want to believe you.

dialogue.t: Give it a try and see. Just use that gun over there.
I'll watch you play this time. Good luck.
I almost want to believe you.
Are they complicated?
Relax, it's easy. Fitting, given the name of this place. You wouldn't be able to find anything "complicated" or "hard" around here even if you tried.
How was it?
Haha, so sure of yourself! Nevertheless, I think you did a great job.
Maybe I can give some suggestions to the staff to have them make improvements down the line.
In any case... They should really let two contestants compete to see who comes out on top.
My eyes... Everything's a blur.
Haha, staying focused takes a lot of energy.
It was fun.
Was it? Then it looks like we've come to the same conclusion.
Great, let's do a headcount. One, two, three, four...
Huh, that's one more than before...
Oh, hello! I'm guessing you're here to take on the main challenge at Wavey Bay? Unfortunately, we've run into a bit of a problem...
But, um... Here, I can still take a group photo for you if you need one for your album...
No... That's not how it's supposed to go!
Photos are just a way to preserve memories, something to look back on and remember all the happy moments. What matters to us is the actual experience itself!
Well, these particular photos can be exchanged for prizes, but... Yeah, okay, you're right. Just snapping a photo and rushing off wouldn't feel right.
I understand, and I'm very sorry about this. Please bear with us a little longer, we'll do our best to resolve the issue as soon as possible...
How long do you think it'll be?
That's hard to say...
Oh, why's that?
Can we do anything to help?
Um...
I noticed you don't have a lot of staff working on the other attractions in Wavey Bay, and the saurian employees seem pretty tired out.
I'm guessing it's because the main attraction ran into trouble, so everyone was temporarily reassigned to help with the repair work?
Relax, I get there are probably things you can't disclose. I'm not trying to make things harder for you.
In fact, I might be able to make your life easier. My companions are all very capable and happy to help out. They just finished testing Twilight Cruise and Asha Speedrun.
If you told us what the issue was, I bet we could help you solve it in no time.
Wow, what a tactful negotiator! Guess that's the hidden power of a Peacemaker...
Wait, Chasca... How did you notice all that? You weren't spying on us from up in some treetop somewhere, were you?
Does that really matter right now...?
What matters... is that we're really good helpers! So, if there's a problem, we're more than happy to do our part to fix it!
Well, your observations were right, down to the detail about our saurians... I'm sorry, I shouldn't have tried to hide anything from you all.
So basically...

During testing, we realized that the Razzle-Dazzle Mega Slide's current paint job still leaves a LOT to be desired. Since it has to be sprayed from the Spiritway, it's a formidable challenge, to say the least.
To avoid delaying the resort's official opening, we had to temporarily shut it down. Right now, we're working around the clock to get it completed.
Haha... You call that a challenge?
Tell me where the paint is, and I'll get it done in one go!
Huh? But... I don't see how you could possibly...
Ah, that's because you've never met her before. This is "Umo{RUBY#[S]Unity}ja" Mualani.
Mualani... Wait a sec, THE Mualani!?
You mean... one of the six heroes? THAT Mualani!?
Great job, Mualani!
Phew... That, was, AWESOME! How was I, guys? Not bad, huh?
It looks incredible! A truly heroic effort, honestly!
Paimon told me all about you while you were out there. Everything you managed to accomplish is so amazing! Seriously, I feel all fired up just thinking about it!
Aww, thanks, haha! I'm so hyped right now, I feel like I could throw a hot spring party right here!
Oh, look! The staff from Wavey Bay are here too! After all that hard work, they must be looking forward to finally letting their hair down!
I think they've got other ideas, actually...
Huh? What do you mean?
Mualani, Mualani! Could I get your autograph?
Me too, please!
Looks like the cat's out of the bag.
Uh oh, better take the group photo now, before the crowd gets here!
Okay, I wanna see big smiles and confident vibes! Think about the ocean, and your lucky colors...
Three, two, one...
Koholasaur!

quests.description: Mualani told you about the many aquatic attractions on offer at Wavey Bay…

quests.title: The World Is Your Canvas!

dialogue.t: I'll buy some jerky for Razor, a box of Saurus Crackers for Klee, and some sweet bread for Fischl...
As for my dads... Something healthy, yet tasty at the same time. Hmm... I know, I'll get them each a Cup O' Grainfruit.
The way things have been looking lately, I'm sure I'll manage to get my hands on some fantastic local specialties and snacks. My bag's gonna be fit to burst!
See? I recommend wearing lake blue, and now all his troubles are gone! I knew I had a knack for lucky colors.
Maybe I should make some lake blue floaters? Or even open a little shop at Easybreeze Market?
Hmm, gotta give it some thought...
Y'know, it's one thing to brave the path of adventure, but to get back out there time and time again even after you fail... Our team captain sure is something.
A true adventurer if I ever saw one.
After all, a bird that's flown through some storms all its life is bound to turn out to be a better flier than those who stay sheltered in their nests.
Alright, let's get some rest.
(Time to rest?)
Just a little longer.
That bed was so comfy. Paimon feels refreshed and ready to go... Which is good, because it's time to get serious about this whole vacation thing!
We're gonna have such a blast today! C'mon, let's go find the others!
Morning, everyone! Sleep well?
Yep, all recharged and ready for an adventure!
Same here! Though I might have overdid it last night... Barely slept at all, haha. Despite that, I feel great!
The bed was a little too soft for my liking... Still, I managed to get up early and go on a morning flight — did the usual north to south loop.
The visibility was great. Looked like perfect weather for exploring the resort.
Sorry, sorry... I'm late, aren't I? Ugh, I'm so not a morning person. Anyway, have we decided where we're gonna start?
Any recommendations?
For me, it's gotta be Wavey Bay! There's so much to do out there on the water. We could spend the whole day there, just choosing activities at random!
I'm leaning more towards Guiztli Ridge. When I flew past there earlier, I caught wind that the town there offers head-to-head challenges.
Anywhere's fine with me! I'm happy to go along with whatever you guys decide.
But if you're asking for my personal preference, I'd love to check out the Foamflower Fields over at Colorfall Cliffs.
I've never been on a hot air balloon that hasn't sprung a leak... It must be amazing, seeing the view of the whole resort from up there... as long as I don't fall out, haha.
Relax, captain. We won't let you fall.
Haha, thanks! But, um, I don't really see myself as a captain or anything. Archon knows I'm not cut out for it... You can just call me Bennett.
As for our itinerary... Why don't we just let {NICKNAME} decide?
Sounds good to me! We're gonna hit all the attractions at some point, anyway, so it's just a matter of where to start.
I'm fine with that too. Letting a trusted friend call the shots sounds like a plan.
No time to lose. Let's go!
In that case, follow me.
Good news, good news! {NICKNAME}—
{NICKNAME}! Can you hear me? Paimon, is he(she) asleep or awake right now?
Must be worn out from all that fun yesterday, huh? Happens to me sometimes, too.
You feel fine when it's all go go go, but then you finally get a chance to rest, and it's like... Good luck ever getting up again, haha.
The meeting spot's been changed — yeah, I already heard you loud and clear from next door... What happened to not being a morning person?
Well, that was when we just got here. Now, I'm in full on vacation mode... obviously.
Uh huh, and why are we waking up earlier and earlier the longer this vacation goes on? That can't be right...
Uh, to maximize our opportunities for fun! C'mon, Paimon, this is basic stuff.
Ah, looks like everyone's here, now. Ahem, okay, I've got some great news to share...
I just checked with the staff, and... Tete Isle is finally open to visitors! Can I get a whoop whoop?
Whoop whoop! Tete Isle, here we come!
How are you feeling now, {NICKNAME}?

dialogue.sit: Let's get this show on the road!

dialogue.t: Woohoo! A brand-new day, a brand-new adventure!
Let's go!
Let's get this show on the road!
I'm all ears... *snore*...
Renowned heroes, daring adventurers from afar, beloved guests, welcome... to Tete Isle!
Whoa, bottle-popping right off the bat? Huh, they're sure going all-in on the atmosphere building...
You got that right! Tete Isle's all about high-energy party vibes!
"From our honey-sweet Aphimead to our exhilarating shows, there's something for all the senses." That's what the brochure says!
Uh, and we're sure this place is rated E for everyone...?
Don't worry about it! I'm sure there are still plenty of things for little Paimon to enjoy.
And if not, I'll personally fund something like that for our next visit! How about... "Mualani's Wibbly-Wobbly Wonderland"? Complete with animal slides, musical rocking chairs, and all!
So... a kids' play area!?

dialogue.sit: When is it open for business?

dialogue.t: C'mon, {NICKNAME}, this way! The Dance-Off Stage is calling your name!
When is it open for business?
Hey, you made it! Welcome! This is—
Ooh, leave this bit to me.
Ta-da! This is the Dance-Off Stage!
Hmm... The name rings a bell, but it sure looks different from the one we know.
It's a Xilonen original. As for the design... I'm guessing probably a client request?
{NICKNAME}, Xilonen recommended you as the DJ! She said you'd be the perfect person to set the place on fire with some high-energy beats.
You sure she didn't say something more normal like... "fire up the crowd"?
Hey, the wilder, the better, right?
How come she didn't come along herself?
Cause she...
Ahem... I think she's pretty swamped with commissions right now.
Yeah, yeah. Anyway, go ahead and give it a spin! She adjusted the modules and stuff to match your height, so it should be a perfect fit.
Hey guys, the Asha just noticed that the area around the stage hasn't been painted or decorated yet. Should we add some color first?
Ooooh, that sounds like a great idea!
This is so awesome! The stage itself even looks like it's dancing!
Paimon can already imagine how amazing the show's gonna be!
Hey DJ, how about a quick spin? Call it a warm-up!
Sure, why not!
Woohoo, shake it!
You called that a warm-up, but... are there really gonna be boats cruising around during the opening ceremony?
Nope! That's when our synergy with {NICKNAME} gets put to the test for real.
You really can't keep a secret, can you?
Hehe... Anyway, time to decide where to head next...
...*sigh* What are we gonna do?
Hey, something up over there?
...Hey, it's that guest in green again. Y'know, the one who showed up first thing this morning.
He hasn't left yet?
I mean, the issue isn't how long he stays... it's whether we run out of Aphimead before he leaves.
Uh oh... Paimon has a funny feeling about this...
Um, sorry to interrupt...
But, that guest you mentioned... Yeah, there's a high probability he might actually be a friend of ours.
Oh... Does a guy with two braids and a little white flower tucked under his hat match who you're thinkin'?
Gah, it really is Tone-Deaf Bard!
You mean Bennett's travel buddy? That bard friend of yours?
Yeah...
But just to be clear, Professor Venti is super responsible! I swear, if this is the first impression he's given you, there must have been some kind of mix-up...
Bennett really hasn't seen the real Venti yet, huh...
Huh...?
Uh... Anyway, your friend's at a bar called The Dewdrop, if you wanted to meet up with him...
Let's go...
Time to rescue Tete Isle.
Let's go ask!
On the breeze drifts a fragrance I've sorely missed; Sunsettia's kiss, so tender, so sweet. But ah — what's this? A fiery twist! A Flaming Flower's fury, a flare of searing heat...
Tone-Deaf Bard! Look at you, sitting here by yourself, sipping away at your drink without a care in the world... You're running this place dry, you know!
Ah, you wound me, fair Paimon! To think, you take me for such an ill-mannered person...
Oh, no you don't! Paimon can see you gearing up to make excuses...
Hmm, just give me a... Got it! Ahem!

Maybe participation in the brewing process was always meant to be a part of the Tete Isle experience? Why else would their stock of mead be so meager? It must be their intention for visitors to help replenish it!
You crafty little...
...Fine. That actually does make sense...
It's been a while, {NICKNAME}! These must be some of your new friends — greetings!
Oh, allow me to introduce you!
This is Mualani. She's unbeatable out on the water — practically owns Wavey Bay!
And this is Chasca. She's super dependable, and so fast that even her bullets can barely keep up with her!
And then there's this Asha, my new adventure buddy. We're really close already!
Hey there, everyone! You can just call me Venti. I like to keep things casual.
Hello.
It's so nice to meet you! Bennett's told us all about you.
Haha, small world — I've heard quite a bit about you from a friend as well.
Oh, who? Kachina? Kinich?
Someone who knows how to party hard... and drink even harder!
C'mon, just tell us already!
(Could he be talking about Mavuika?)
It's a secret, and I expect anyone who's guessed the answer to keep it that way.
Man, you're nothing like I thought you'd be.
When I heard Bennett call you "Professor"... In all honesty, I figured you'd be a lot older!
Ah, well, when I do turn old and gray, I hope I get the chance to hold another love poem crash course...
Ahem! "You and the Mare Jivari/So close and yet so far/One at the edge of the world/The other in the center of my heart."

dialogue.sit: Hey, wasn't that the poem Bennett wrote?
Your poetic prowess never ceases to amaze, Prof!

dialogue.t: Well remembered, {NICKNAME}.
No matter how old I get, I don't think I'll ever forget the poems my students wrote that year. Such a charming little verse... Mm, a charming little verse indeed.
Ugh... Now's probably not the time for a trip down memory lane, is it?
Right you are! Now's the time to raise a glass in celebration of new friendships.
Bartender, a few more glasses of that refreshing Aphimead I was just enjoying, if you'd be so kind!
I'm afraid you just polished off the very last glass.
Oh, heh... That's an unlucky coincidence.

Our exceptionally.... um, well-hydrated guest is certainly right about one thing, however — you're all more than welcome to take part in the "Honeydew Craftbrew" experience and try brewing some yourselves!
...Any takers?
Me and hydration station over here will both give it a try.
Sounds great! Where's it taking place?
That didn't take too much convincing...
Well, since {NICKNAME} was kind enough to answer on my behalf, how could I possibly turn down such a warm invitation?
It's just over there, if you're interested.
In that case, why don't we all split up for a bit? We can pick a spot to regroup, and meet up there later.
Oh, I know a place — a little bar called Me & Dew. It's a great place to relax, and there's more than enough mead to go around.
Alright, let's meet there later, then!
Oho, Me & Dew, just Me & Dew... Such an aptly poetic name for what I'm sure is a veritable temple of inspiration!
Uh-uh, don't try to bat your eyelashes at Paimon! You're not allowed in another bar until you've at least attempted to replenish what you drank.
Ah, well, I suppose you're right...
Anyway, judging from the look on your face, I'm guessing you have quite a few questions for me.
"Why are you here? What brings you to Natlan? And why are you suddenly bringing up your poetry class?"
But questions, dear friends, are like bottles of fine wine — cracking them open is all about waiting for the right moment.
Your poetic prowess never ceases to amaze, Prof!
Ah, that one was Bennett's handiwork, not mine.
Dude, play me something intense... I need to unwind.
Yo, man! I've got you.
Ah, you must be the guest in green I've been hearing about... the one who cleaned out our entire stock of mead!
Hehe, word sure spreads fast, huh?
My sincerest apologies. It wasn't intentional, I assure you. The mead was just so irresistible, I felt like lowering my glass would have been an insult to your craft!
My... How very kind of you. Guests of your... tolerance level are hard to come by. I meant no offense, either. Please, enjoy as much of our mead as you want...
Hehe, in that case, once I'm done here, I'll be sure to head back for a refill!
He was being polite, Venti. Not giving you a return ticket to booze town!
Haha, hah— ahem... Anyway, before the Honeydew Craftbrew experience officially begins, allow me to give you some background.
Aphids play the central role in the brewing of Tete Isle's Aphimead.

First, we guide the aphids to gather ripened honeydew from the brewing barrels, which we then collect inside a special device. After that, we refine it using the strength of our tatankasaur companions.
With a splash of added flavor or alcohol, the base can be transformed into a range of unique kinds of Aphimead.
So it's the aphids who do most of the work? Now that's something you don't see in Mondstadt.
All done!
Who'd have thought it'd be such a breeze? Those little aphids really pull their weight!
Hey, we should invite Diluc over to check it out. You'll be lapping up Aphimead over at the Angel's Share in no time!
Wait, nope. Scratch that. The last thing you need is more access to this stuff...
Forget about Master Diluc — let's just sneak a couple of aphids into our pockets and bring them back ourselves!
And if we can't fit them in a pocket, we can always try stuffing them under a hat!
Haha, your friend's quite the joker.
He is... joking... right?
Hey friends, we're here!
Professor Venti, we were just talking about you!
We made a bet.
Oh, on what? How much I can drink? Who guessed the most?
Nope, we can't bet on that because, well... We've all seen it for ourselves.
We were betting on whether you'd agree to recite one of your poems for us!
And? What was the verdict?
We all bet that you wouldn't.
Aha, trying a bit of reverse psychology, are we?
That's a move I like to call the "Wind Catcher"!
Told you, this bard's a lot sharper than he lets on.
Haha, I appreciate the compliment!
But you see, the key ingredient in the honey of inspiration is sweet, sweet nectar.
Ugh, Paimon knows exactly what that means... He's still not done drinking...
Well you're in luck, 'cause Bennett already looked into that for you.
Mm-hmm! The boss said we just need to tell her when, and we'll be able to get some more!
Oh, your friend's here now? Bear with me for one second while I get the equipment up and running...
A Whopperflower!? Where did that come from?
Stand back, everyone, and clear the furniture. I'll handle this!
Phew, nothing got wrecked. How's Bennett?
Haha...
Is Bennett... laughing?
Back in Mondstadt, whenever I gather flowers, at least half of them turn out to be Whopperflowers, guaranteed...
So, thanks to my bad luck, dealing with them is a piece of cake at this point. This one put up a fight, but I got it in the end!
Out of sight out of mind. C'mon, it's finally time for a toast!
I appreciate your help, brave adventurers... Though I do have one more favor to ask.
Well, looks like the party's getting postponed again.
I checked the equipment, and it looks like the Whopperflower was hiding among our Brewblossoms. In other words... there might be a few more lying low in our store room.
All I need is for you to head down to the cellar and clear out those pesky imposters. If you can manage it, all your drinks tonight are on the house!
Eh-he, in that case, you can count me in too!
A... dainty bard like you? Sure you can manage it?
Ah, never doubt the morale boosting power of a song! Just make sure to give me a moment to find a safe little corner to hide in.
Thanks, everyone! Give me a moment, I'll take care of the rest.
That should just about do it, right? If I'd known it'd take this long, I would've ordered something to eat...
I've got a Grainfruit on me. Want some?
Thanks, but no thanks. How'd you even think to bring one of those?
I didn't. A qucusaur gave it to me on the way here, said it was nice and juicy.
So, qucusaurs just give you fruit wherever you go? You Flower-Feather Clan folks live quite the life...
Everyone, please make your way to the observation deck!

dialogue.sit: (Camera shows nectar being gathered, followed by a timeline of a spraying bottle.)

dialogue.t: Whoa!
Wow, now that's what I call a breathtaking sight! Tete Isle was totally worth saving till last!
A moment all the more precious because of the toil that shaped it...
Well said, bard. For that, you deserve a toast...
Speaking of which, where's our drinks?
Coming right up!
Hehe, I don't know about the rest of you... But, I would much prefer to be outdoors right now.
Why don't we take our food and drinks on the go and have ourselves a picnic on the mountain?
Great idea!
Whoa, whoa, whoa, hold on... Shouldn't we take a photo first?
C'mon, Mualani. You've done how many countdowns so far? Why is Paimon the one remembering this stuff?
Hehe, 'cause I care more about the party than the prize.
You get in the photo too, Venti.
Hmm? Oh, sure.
Look at the camera, everyone! Ready?
Three, two, one...
Let's party!
Nothing else is gonna pop out at us, right? We're in the clear? Just gonna do a quick countdown to be safe... Three, two, one...
Ahem, alrighty then, everyone...
Cheers!
Mmm, now that hit the spot!
It's getting dark, so we'd better call it a day. Get some rest tonight, guys — we can claim our prizes tomorrow.
Hey, what about the food! Let's dig in while it's still hot! Mmm... Meat beats Grainfruit any day of the week!
I'm with you on that!

dialogue.sit: You begin to swap stories from your journey, gazing out at the sunset and stunning scenery before you...
Ahh... After a meal like that, all Paimon wants to do is just flop down on the grass.
By the time you've all had your fill, the night sky is ablaze with stars...

dialogue.t: Ahh... After a meal like that, all Paimon wants to do is just flop down on the grass.
Then go ahead and flop! Who's stopping you?
Wanna join in, little buddy?
Look at all those beautiful stars!
Careful, you nearly knocked my hat off...
Hehehe, sorry...
Such a relaxing atmosphere.
Yeah...
"Never has a ray of light lingered so enduring / Falling from the heavens / Soft as moonlight's mirth."
"Hanging on the hush of night a sleepless song alluring / Blossom fills the gentle folds that cross the smiling earth."

quests.description: The warm sunlight shines on your back, urging you to set off once again. Well, what are you waiting for? Stretch your legs and enjoy the Easybreeze Holiday Resort with all your friends!

quests.title: Time to Test the Twilight Cruise!

dialogue.t: You're here! Looks like the staff had to step out for a bit, but I've pretty much figured out how to take it for a spin... ahem, yeah, for testing purposes!
Great, then show us the ropes!
Basically, one person rides the boat while the other sends signals to the saurian staff. Working as a team, the aim is to safely guide the boat to its destination.
So I'm pretty confident — 'cause when it comes to teamwork, {NICKNAME} and I have it down to a T!
Oh really? Well, don't get too confident, or you might end up capsizing...
Whoa, Paimon, don't go around jinxing people!
Okay, okay... Then Paimon wishes you... smooth sailing?
Hehe, that goes without saying.
I'm actually kind of in the mood to ride the boat. I'm used to tough surfing challenges, so it'll be fun to switch it up!

dialogue.sit: I'm kinda tired of the Waverider too.
I'll take care of the signals.

dialogue.t: See, we're in perfect sync already! That's gotta be proof of our bond, huh?
Can't wait to pump up my inflatable swimsuit and bounce right onto the boat!
I'll take care of the signals.
...Oh, so the facilities here are still under construction.
Look, there's an iktomisaur employee! Should we ask him for help?
Hi there! Any chance you could give us a hand getting these built?
Um... Put... here... and build...
Doesn't look like he understands...
Yeah... Hmm, what should we do now?
...Ohhhhh, hold on! A stroke of genius just came to me!
Eee!
Eee! Eee! Eee!
Hah, nope... Well at least we know he doesn't speak koholasaur!
Why don't we just—
Oh, I've got another idea!
What now?
I once heard Ifa mention that iktomisaurs go wild for Glowing Hornshrooms, and guess what I happen to have on me...?
This has gotta be it! Once he eats this, we'll totally be on the same wavelength!
There's no such thing as packing too much when you're heading out on a long trip... Kachina was spot on. Gotta remember to thank her for this...
Uhhh, whatever that was, it's definitely not the wavelength Paimon's on...
What a disaster... Day one, and there goes my dream of conquering all the challenges in Wavey Bay...
Got any ideas, {NICKNAME}, o great hero of Natlan...?

dialogue.sit: I can fetch another iktomisaur to help.

dialogue.t: Okay, let's try that. Appreciate it, {NICKNAME}!
I can fetch another iktomisaur to help.

dialogue.sit: You return, having indwelt an iktomisaurus...

dialogue.t: Mualani, we're back!
Oh, hey there! Aww, aren't you just the cutest? Wait, where'd {NICKNAME} go?
Uh, he(she)... His(Her) stomach started acting up, so he(she) had to run to the bathroom...
(Seriously Paimon, that's such a lame cover story. Never mind, as long as Mualani buys it...)
My, you're a friendly one! Wanna try a Glowing Hornshroom? Here, have at it!
(A curious flavor, indeed. Thick, juicy, and surprisingly delicious, for a mushroom...)
Haha, glad you liked it! Here, they're all yours.
C—Can I pet you? C'mon, let's be friends!
Also, could you... do me a favor?
What is she yammering on about!? I don't understand. My friend asked me to look after this place... No one said anything about manual labor...
But those mushrooms tasted nice... If it means I can get some more of them...
Phew, looks like we're all done!
Thank you! I couldn't have done it without your help.
Mind if I pet you again? Aww, that's a good little buddy... You're the best!
Um... Mualani, it's probably about time we took our friend back home.
Oh, sure. I'll wait here in case {NICKNAME} gets back in the meantime.
Such cute little things! Maybe I should get Granny to teach me some iktomisaur...
Oh, hey {NICKNAME}, how's the stomach?
Absolutely fine, thanks.
Glad to hear it. Oh, you won't believe it — you just missed the sweetest little iktomisaur! Seriously, so adorable!
It almost makes me wanna go stay with the Masters of the Night-Wind for a while, just so I can pick some more Glowing Hornshrooms and spend some time bonding with them!

quests.description: The flagship attraction, “Twilight Cruise,” is waiting for professional testers…

quests.title: Time to Test the Asha Speedrun!

dialogue.t: ...I'm sorry, but we can't let you take that risk.
But that's not what you said earlier...
Our sincerest apologies. We may be pressed for time, but the safety of our visitors has to come first. We hope you understand.
Oh, {NICKNAME}! Perfect timing! Could you help me talk this gentleman around?
They need someone for the testing, so I went over all my adventuring experience, made it clear I was willing to accept any risks... It was all going so well...
But the minute I mentioned some of the close calls I've had in the past, he flat-out refused to let me take part.
Sir, I appreciate your enthusiasm, I truly do.

But if you, in your own words, have a tendency to fall into rivers even when you're crossing a bridge made of solid stone, it might be better to try something a little more... laid-back? Like, lounging on one of those beach chairs over there.
*sigh* But... I really am an adventurer, and I'm qualified for the testing too! I've just... had some bad luck in the past, that's all...
I really want to help. You can count on me, I swear!
Well, if the savior of Natlan says so... How about this — would it be alright if your Asha companion completed the first round of testing instead?
You can watch from the sidelines, familiarize yourself with the route, and if everything goes smoothly, you can join the second round of testing.
Does that sound good to you, buddy?
Alright then! I'll leave it to you, partner!
He has my full confidence.
You did it! See, it wasn't that tricky after all.
Well done, buddy! You were quite the athlete out there! I was blown away!
It's Bennett's turn next, right?
Yep! I've done my warm-up, finished my stretches, and I'm ready for action. Trust me, I've got this!
Be careful out there.
Thanks for looking out for me, {NICKNAME}! But, don't worry, I will be!
You're saying... You'd be willing to lead the way and coach me through it?
You're the best! Now, I feel even more confident than before. After you, Coach!
Go, Asha! Go, Bennett!
Okay, just a little further. Stay calm...
Wait, what!? Where did the finish line go...?
Oh no, did I just jinx myself? Or use up all my luck? ...No, c'mon, I can't lose hope now.
That's right, I can always follow my Asha buddy! Just gotta trust our connection...
Whew, my heart's racing so fast... Gotta take a while to catch my breath...
Let's give it up for Bennett and his Asha buddy! You guys make such a great team!
Especially the way you worked together at the end. Your special bond made all the difference!
You turned the tide of misfortune together.
We sure did!
I owe a big thanks to you in particular, {NICKNAME}.
If you hadn't believed in me and helped convince the staff, I never would have had the chance to even compete in the challenge, let alone face it alongside our Asha friend...
Mr. Bennett, the final safety test has been completed, which means that Asha Speedrun is now officially ready to open. Your help was much appreciated!
Did you hear that, Asha? We did it!
I'll remember your name, Mr. Bennett — the brave and kind-hearted adventurer.
I know this adventure isn't over yet, but just the idea of saying goodbye is getting harder and harder to bear...
Asha, I'm really gonna miss you.
Hehe, hey... If anything, I should be the one doing the comforting here! As the leader of this Adventure Team, it's my job to look after you.
Huh, something must've gotten in my eyes out there... Getting a bit watery, haha... Got a bit of a lump in my throat too...
I'll have to ask Professor Venti how to express my feelings in moments like this. After all, he's the best poet I know...
Tone-Deaf Bard would just say something like...
Speak from the heart.
It really means a lot to have you here by my side... Thank you, Asha.

quests.description: The flagship attraction, “Asha Speedrun,” is waiting for professional testers…
